paragraphs: 3 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Friday for 3 clubs across 3 levels, with Ryan Stafford producing the night's most notable performance.
Ryan Stafford drove in his lone run with a single in the second to right field on a 0-1 pitch from Draven Zeigler.
He batted ninth and started behind the plate.
Frederick Keys fell to Greensboro Grasshoppers, 5-7.

Zach Daudet went 0-for-2, 1 run scored, 2 walks for Corpus Christi Hooks at Double-A. Zach Daudet produced a walk in the ninth on a 3-0 pitch from Blaze Pontes. He batted eighth and started at third base. Corpus Christi Hooks beat Midland RockHounds, 5-2.
Brooks Lee went 0-for-4 for Minnesota Twins. He batted seventh and started at third base. Minnesota Twins fell to Cleveland Guardians, 2-5.
title: Ryan Stafford highlights a busy Friday for former Mustangs
